claims.quote: Type locality is given as 'Rio Negro; Rio Branco; and Essiquibo River, South America', and this species is widely distributed throughout northern drainages of the Amazon in Peru, Ecuador and Brazil plus the Río Orinoco in Venezuela and various coastal river systems in Guyana, Suriname and French Guiana.
